user.title: Connect to the KONE API
user.description: Use the client ID and secret of an application you created in the KONE API Portal (dev.kone.com). Sandbox and production applications both use the dev.kone.com host unless KONE has given you another.

data_description.allow_control: Off: monitoring only. Nothing this integration does can call, cancel or otherwise change how a lift operates. On: adds Call/Cancel buttons and the call_lift and cancel_call actions.

choose.title: Choose buildings
choose.description: Your application can see {found} building(s). Tick the ones to add, or type building IDs (comma separated) if a building is not listed.

building.title: Building {building_id}
building.description: Lift groups enable lift calls and live monitoring (Elevator Call API). Equipment enables status polling (Equipment Status API). Leave either empty if your application is not subscribed to that API.

error.invalid_auth: KONE rejected the client ID or secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the KONE API.
error.nothing_selected: Add at least one lift group or one piece of equipment.
error.scope_refused: KONE refused access to one of the chosen groups or equipment. Check that your application has been granted them in the API Portal.

abort.already_configured: This KONE application is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the KONE API.

data_description.allow_control: Off makes this connection read-only: call buttons and floor pickers are removed and lift call actions are refused.

error.nothing_selected: Add at least one lift group or one piece of equipment.
error.scope_refused: KONE refused access to one of the chosen groups or equipment.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the KONE API.

call_lift.name: Call lift
call_lift.description: Place a lift call through the KONE Elevator Call API.

device_id.name: Lift group
device_id.description: The lift group device. Or give building_id and group_id.

group_id.name: Group ID
group_id.description: Lift group ID within the building.

from_floor.name: From floor
from_floor.description: Floor label as on the lift buttons (e.g. G) or an area ID.

to_floor.name: To floor
to_floor.description: Destination floor label or area ID. Leave empty for a landing call.

action.name: Action
action.description: KONE call action code. 2 is a destination call; the group's Last call sensor lists the site's actions.

terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.description: Terminal ID; defaults to the building's configured terminal.

cancel_call.name: Cancel call
cancel_call.description: Cancel a lift call. Defaults to the group's last call.

refresh_topology.name: Refresh floors
refresh_topology.description: Fetch the group's lifts and floors from KONE again.
